text:
Maria: Heads-up — we have 12 customers on the waitlist for next week's enablement office hours. Can we batch into two 6-person sessions?
Jae: +1 from infra — prefer smaller groups for hands-on. timezone spread?
Anna: Most are PST/EST; 3 APAC. If we do two sessions, one ASAP for NA mornings and one late afternoon to catch APAC overlap.
Oliver: Agenda reminder: 1) migration checklist 2) dedicated capacity Q&A 3) breakout labs (30m). OK to shorten to 20m?
Maria: I think 20m labs + a follow-up drop-in works. Who can host the second session?
Jae: I can take the APAC-friendly session (late-afternoon). React with :raised_hand: if you can co-host the NA morning one.
Anna: I'll co-host NA session. I'll create calendar invites and a short prep doc.
OnboardBot: new poll created — /poll "Preferred session" "Tue 9am PT" "Tue 2pm PT" "Wed 4pm PT" — results in 24h.
Maria: Also we need to capture feedback for renewal signals — add a quick 3-question form at end (NPS + blocker + ask). Anna can you add link to invite?
Anna: Yep, will attach a form (1min) and add a routing tag so CS can triage any 'blocker' responses.
Oliver: Can we include a slide about rollout best practices and recommended quant profiles? 3 slides max.
Jae: I'll drop config snippets in the prep doc:
```
redwoodctl rollout create --model t-4-batch --batch-size 16 --kv-cache enabled
```
Maria: Perfect. Anna — target invites out by EOD?
Anna: On it. I'll also message customers individually for the ones with renewal at-risk flag.
Maria: Thanks. If poll leans to Tue 2pm PT we'll open second waitlist for overflow.
OnboardBot: poll closed — results: Tue 9am PT (4), Tue 2pm PT (6), Wed 4pm PT (2).
Maria: Looks like Tue 2pm PT wins. Session owners: NA morning -> Maria & Anna? wait that's 9am. But majority picked 2pm so that's the one Jae will host (APAC overlap) and Maria+Anna will co-host the overflow at 9am.
Oliver: I'll prepare the three-slide best practices and upload to invites.
Anna: Calendar invites sent + form attached. Customers flagged 'at-risk' notified privately.
Maria: Great. Please drop the recording + slides in the enablement repo and ping #cs for follow-ups.
Jae: Will record and pin to the thread.
Maria: Thanks team :tada:
